PMID 15355889 resolves; quote verbatim. Target hit held (saturating trastuzumab in all 11 tumours); what failed is the model's mechanism (down-modulation, proliferation), which Gennari frames as mechanism of action, not engagement. Quote 'saturating level of trastuzumab was present in all of the tumors'; keep the miss in judgement.

Genentech's own model (Jumbe 2010, doi 10.1007/s10928-010-9156-2) states no clinical comparison in its abstract, so 2013 stands. PMID 9661897 resolves; quote verbatim; untested fine.

DOI resolves (PMID 11248153); quote verbatim (abstract). Trial paper; abstract makes no model-vs-patient comparison and draft marks comparison_stated false, so rule 1 strictly gives untested unless the paywalled full text states the xenograft-synergy rationale. H0648g predates the registry; null correct.

Quote evidences xenografts only, not the toxicology half of the model. EMA Herceptin EPAR (EMEA 2005) names 4-week rhesus and 12/26-week cynomolgus studies: use it for quote and model (rhesus+cynomolgus, not cynomolgus alone); model_filed should be true.

Slamon 2001 verbatim but states no animal comparison, so rule 1 fails as cited. EMA EPAR scientific discussion (EMEA 2005, Part III Cardiotoxicity) does: rhesus trastuzumab+doxorubicin 'had previously shown no evidence for cardiac effects'; mouse/dog models unsuitable. Move contra there; FDA 1998 pharm/tox review not posted; 2000 and 2026 labels silent on animals.

missing: safety: EMA Herceptin EPAR scientific discussion, https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/scientific-discussion/herceptin-epar-scientific-discussion_en.pdf (EMEA 2005, 'updated until 30 November 2004'). Primary regulatory source stating the comparison: 'Preclinical studies have been undertaken in an attempt to elucidate the mechanism for the enhanced cardiotoxicity observed in some clinical-trial patients receiving trastuzumab in combination with an anthracycline-based cytotoxic such as doxorubicin.' and 'Single-dose studies in rhesus monkeys with the trastuzumab-doxorubicin combination (both at 1.5 mg/kg) had previously shown no evidence for cardiac effects.' Also: Cytoxan/Adriamycin + trastuzumab in rhesus 'did not elicit significant findings on ... electrocardiograms'. comparison_stated true, subjects patients, model_filed true.

safety (earlier year candidate, not primary): Klein & Dybdal 2003, Semin Oncol 30(5 Suppl 16):49-53, doi 10.1053/j.seminoncol.2003.08.007 (PMID 14613026), Genentech 'update on preclinical studies' of cardiac dysfunction; PubMed types it Review and the abstract has no quotable model-vs-patient sentence.

dose entry 2 registry_date: TDM3569g phase I (NCT00932373, Genentech) resultsFirstPostDate 2015-07-30 (type ESTIMATED), studyFirstPost 2009-07-03. Applies only if Haddish-Berhane's 'clinical doses' trace to this trial (abstract does not say which).

registry for Slamon 2001 (H0648g, started 1995) and Gennari 2004 (Italian pilot): no NCT found (no Genentech trastuzumab trial starting before 1998 in ClinicalTrials.gov); registry_date null is correct, not a gap.

model_filed (checker item 3): Herceptin label Rev 05/2026 section 12.1 reads 'Herceptin has been shown, in both in vitro assays and in animals, to inhibit the proliferation of human tumor cells that overexpress HER2.' The 2000 label (Revised January 2000) carries the same sentence under Clinical Pharmacology/General. Neither names SK-BR-3, BT-474 or a xenograft; true is defensible at the class level only. Section 13.1 names only a cynomolgus fertility study; no section 13.2 and no animal cardiac statement in any label version checked.

FDA 1998 review: Drugs@FDA for BLA 103792 posts for ORIG-1 only the 1998 label, approval letter and an archived 'Review' web page (web.archive.org, not fetchable from this tool); no pharmacology/toxicology review PDF.

engagement (if flipped to same): Spector 2005 (doi 10.1200/JCO.2005.12.157, PMID 15684311) is a second match for lapatinib, but its abstract says biomarker inhibition was 'variable' and occurred in nonresponders too, across mixed tumour types; weaker than the draft's judgement states. Mohsin 2005 (doi 10.1200/JCO.2005.00.661, PMID 15710948) and Seidman 2002 (doi 10.1200/JCO.2002.20.5.1215, PMID 11870163) resolve as cited.
rule_questions: Engagement scope: does the cell cover target occupancy only, or also the model's proximal PD readout? Gennari 2004 shows saturation held while HER2 down-modulation and proliferation did not change. Occupancy-only gives same; PD-inclusive gives contra. The brief's wording ('hit its target ... the way the model said') does not decide it.

Does a trial paper that reports the model-predicted outcome without itself citing or comparing to the model (comparison_stated=false) satisfy rule 1? Decides efficacy entry 2 (Slamon 2001) and, as drafted, safety entry 2. If no, both are untested until a comparing source is cited.

Is an EMA EPAR scientific discussion an acceptable primary regulatory source? Rule 1 names FDA label/review only; the v2 fact field model_filed says 'FDA/EMA'. If yes, which year for a consolidated EPAR: document year (EMEA 2005) or the original opinion year (2000)? The cardiotoxicity text almost certainly predates the 2004 update.

Can a sponsor-authored review of its own unpublished preclinical data (Klein & Dybdal 2003) set the strip year when it is the earliest published comparison? Rule 1 says reviews are not sources, which here pushes the contra later than the knowledge actually existed.
